other_share_source: Median of the residual 'other depository institutions' divided by H.4.1 reserves over the 211 H.8 weeks from 2022-08-10 to 2026-08-19 on which the retired anchored build (latest-filed Call Report RC-A item 0090, moved by the H.8 and with the break refusal switched off) could be computed: median 0.0862, range -0.009 to 0.163 (docs/research/rca-fed-balances-due-diligence.md, section 7). A full-sample constant from latest-filed data, so a retrospective calibration and not a point-in-time figure; the value is rounded to 0.086 and is Eleonora's to confirm or replace.
